analyzed_vuln.description: `zfp_getcell` unconditionally dereferences `context->schunk` at line 737 and trusts it to be a valid super-chunk, unlike the normal ZFP decoder which validates `dparams->schunk`. In this path the caller is the context-free `blosc2_getitem()` used by `get_coffset`; that API populates `context.schunk` from the unrelated global `g_schunk`, so it may be NULL, stale, or otherwise invalid. A crafted offsets chunk labeled as the ZFP fixed-rate codec therefore reaches the ZFP get-cell optimization and performs a wild read through the invalid schunk pointer. The immediate patch-relevant defect is the missing valid-schunck check in `zfp_getcell` (and the caller should fall back/report malformed data when no associated schunk exists).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Supply an otherwise parseable in-memory Blosc2 frame whose compressed chunk-offset index has an extended Blosc chunk header selecting `BLOSC_CODEC_ZFP_FIXED_RATE`, with valid enough sizes/block metadata and a requested item so `_blosc_getitem` sets `zfp_cell_nitems > 0`. Frame decompression calls `get_coffset`, which passes this attacker-controlled offsets chunk to context-free `blosc2_getitem`; `blosc_d` then calls `zfp_getcell`. Because this temporary getitem context has no reliably associated frame super-chunk (it uses `g_schunk`), dereferencing `context->schunk->blockshape` causes the observed wild-address read before compressed ZFP contents are meaningfully decoded.

args: What is the safest project-idiomatic way to decode one int64 offset in `get_coffset()` at c-blosc2/blosc/frame.c:2025 while ensuring a ZFP get-cell codec sees the frame's actual schunk rather than global `g_schunk`? Can `frame->schunk->dctx` and `blosc2_getitem_ctx` be used, and are there concurrency/state concerns? Also explain what invariants zfp_getcell should validate before using schunk metadata.

The reported crash is in c-blosc2/plugins/codecs/zfp/blosc2-zfp.c:737, where zfp_getcell unconditionally dereferences context->schunk. The call comes from c-blosc2/blosc/frame.c get_coffset, which currently invokes context-free blosc2_getitem on an attacker-controlled compressed offsets chunk. blosc2_getitem assigns context.schunk from global g_schunk, so it can be NULL/stale/unrelated. I am considering both a mandatory null check in zfp_getcell and changing get_coffset to use a decompression context associated with frame->schunk. I need to preserve normal offset decoding and avoid abusing an existing dctx if this operation requires its own context.
